frozen_e11_calculation.gaussian_symmetric_two_point: E_r[T_ell,s(r)]=0, exactly odd under r reversal. Original unconditional cross-power wake mean stays zero under the stated independent/symmetric rank model.
frozen_e11_calculation.gaussian_three_point_response: Gamma_ell,s=E_r[r*T_ell,s(r)]=E_r[dT_ell,s/dr]. For a jointly Gaussian long scalar D_L(K) and r(x), E[D_L(K) T_ell,s(r(x))]=exp(-iKx) P_(D_L,r)(K) Gamma_ell,s. Requires P_(D_L,r)(K) independently calibrated. Nonzero Gamma alone does NOT establish actual observed eBOSS bispectrum or significance.
frozen_e11_calculation.physical_geometry: For irrotational v_rel,L(K)=i Khat V_rel,L(K) zeta(K), scalar-long D_L(K)=T_L(K) zeta(K), P_(D_L,r) proportional to i (Khat dot n) T_L V_rel P_zeta/sigma_LOS, with Fourier sign convention explicitly tracked. No external preferred wind vector. Wind-conditioned local two-tracer Fourier odd couples to long-mode density through its correlated velocity, producing a squeezed bispectrum-like response instead of an unconditional odd 2-point mean.
